title: Ombelle project configuration (ui-library.config.json)
description: Written by init and theme add; read by every command. configVersion 1 is the 1.0 format. A higher configVersion is refused as written by a newer CLI.

presetFile.description: The saved project preset, relative to the app root (./ui-preset.json).

lockFile.description: The project lock, relative to the app root (./ui-library.lock.json).

packageManager.description: Must agree with the app's lockfile or packageManager field; auto follows them.

cssEntry.description: The global stylesheet theme add merges tokens into.

components.description: Must match components.json aliases.ui and tsconfig paths.

recipeOutput.description: Reserved; recipes refuse a custom output root.

registryBase.description: Reserved; not read by the 1.0 CLI.
